auditNotes.verifyMethodPolicy: store-api accepted; OOS-transition / restock alerts may miss for products the batch API never saw (worker.ts:549/711 early-return). Acceptable for this 122-product gun-parts site where catalog churn is slow and per-product detail-page Playwright cost would be ~10min/crawl. Operator may flip to detail-page if restock alerts become important.
auditNotes.catalogUrlsRationale: Site has 122 total products (121 customer-visible). 23 top-level categories with heavy multi-tag overlap (one product appears in N categories - e.g. a TM22 handguard sits in both "Handguards and Grips" and "Derya TM22"). The single /shop/ URL is the canonical newest-first sorted aggregator, walks 6 pages (perPage=21) in 6 fetches to cover 100% of customer-visible products. Per-category list would require 23 catalogUrls covering the same 121 products via 30-50 fetches with heavy dedup, no coverage benefit. Stage 4d walk-and-dedup of /shop/ pages 1..6 returned 121 unique product IDs matching the HTML result-count line byte-for-byte.
auditNotes.sortVerification: Stage 6 3-outcome counter-control: default first-5 IDs = [6216,6115,6109,5939,5865] == ?orderby=date first-5 IDs (both newest-first), and != ?orderby=price first-5 IDs [1084,4501,195,142,173]. Verdict: honored-default-is-newest. Within-page IDs descend monotonically (6216->2571 on page 1, 2566->1373 on page 2) and max-per-page descends across pages.
auditNotes.paginationVerification: Stage 5 page-1 vs page-2 zero-overlap test: page 1 IDs = [6216..2571] (21 IDs), page 2 IDs = [2566..1373] (21 IDs), overlap = 0. Pattern /page/{N}/ confirmed.
auditNotes.perPageProbe: ?per_page=100 query param silently ignored (still 21 products returned). Theme is Flatsome and locks the perPage at 21 via large-columns-3 grid template. Runtime walker must accept perPage=21 - do NOT attempt to inflate via query param.
